title.zh: v2.0.27 钢琴卷帘与和弦数据全链路一致性同步：查看器精准映射打开轨道、卷帘真和弦堆叠呈现与编辑、MIDI/Ableton 导出真和弦音符多音对齐
title.en: v2.0.27 Piano Roll and Chord Data Synchronization: Inspector target track accuracy, true chord stack rendering & editing, and multi-note export parity for MIDI and Ableton Live Sets

highlights.zh: **查看器打开卷帘精准定向（Track Inspector Target Track Binding）**：修复在任意轨道查看器（TrackInspector）点击「打开钢琴卷帘」时被硬编码逻辑无条件重定向到首个旋律轨（贝斯）的问题。现在精准透传当前检查的轨道索引，并在卷帘轨选择器中支持当前轨道显示，无论在和弦、主音、贝斯或打击乐查看器打开，卷帘均忠实展示该轨对应内容。
highlights.en: **Target Track Binding**: Fixed an issue where clicking "Open Piano Roll" in TrackInspector unconditionally redirected to the first melodic track (bass). Now precisely binds and displays the inspected track index in both the piano roll lane and selector.

highlights.zh: **和弦卷帘多音真实堆叠与读写双向同步**：在卷帘模型中为和弦轨引入调式 voicing 兜底，消除和弦轨在未固化音堆时只显示单音的缺陷；解决 React key 冲突警告；在序列器状态机（SET_PITCH / BATCH_SET_PITCH）中引入音堆与根音的同步移调约束，确保卷帘编辑、网格修改与音高变动时 pitch（根音）与 pitches（全音堆）始终保持严格一致。
highlights.en: **True Chord Stack Rendering & Bi-directional State Sync**: Notes in the piano roll now synthesize full chord voicings even when unexpanded; resolved React child key collision warnings; synchronized pitch (root) and pitches (stack) in reducer actions (SET_PITCH / BATCH_SET_PITCH) to ensure seamless data coherence across the UI.

highlights.zh: **导出端全音符多音对齐与单步试听对齐**：彻底移除 MidiExporter 与 AbletonExporter 之前写死的伪小三和弦（+0, +3, +7）硬编码，统一调用 track.pitches 与 chordNotesForStep 生成真和弦 MIDI 事件；同时在步进网格点击试听时传递 stepIdx，使网格点击试听、序列器实时播放、WAV 离线渲染、MIDI 导出与 Ableton 工程导出全部使用完全同一份真和弦数据。
highlights.en: **Exporters & Audition Parity**: Replaced hardcoded minor triad offsets in MidiExporter and AbletonExporter with true note stacks derived from track.pitches and chordNotesForStep. Grid audition now receives stepIdx to audition the exact stored chord stack, achieving 100% data fidelity across editing, auditioning, live playback, WAV export, MIDI export, and Ableton export.
